title: PT2 — Design a Model Filipino House
summary: Design and build a model house that demonstrates physics principles (rotational dynamics, energy efficiency, sound, and light) suited to Filipino homes.
instructions:
Your task is to design and construct a physical or digital model of a Filipino home that showcases physics principles in action. You will:

  1. Sketch a floor plan — at least 4 rooms (living area, kitchen, bathroom, and one bedroom).
  2. Integrate at least 3 physics concepts into the design, choosing from:
    • Rotational dynamics: ceiling fans, doorknobs, rotating vent windows (jalousies), or water pumps
    • Energy efficiency: natural ventilation (cross-breeze layout), roof orientation for heat reduction, LED lighting plan
    • Sound: soundproofing for the bedroom or noise-reducing layout near streets
    • Light: window placement for natural daylighting, use of reflective surfaces, or mirrors for brightness
  3. Provide a written explanation (2–3 pages) of how each physics concept is applied.
  4. Build a scale model (physical or digital — SketchUp, Tinkercad, or cardboard).
  5. Include a photo or video tour of your model as part of your submission.

Format: Submit a PDF report + photos/video of your model. If digital, share the file link in the reflection.
requirements: Floor plan with at least 4 rooms clearly labeled
At least 3 physics concepts integrated and explained
Scale model — physical or digital (photo/video required)
Consideration of Filipino climate (heat, rain, typhoons)
Proper citation of any references used
options: Physical scale model (cardboard, foam board, or recycled materials)
Digital 3D model (SketchUp, Tinkercad, Blender, or similar)

rubric.criterion: Physics concepts correctly identified and applied (depth and accuracy)
Design quality — model, floor plan, and layout
